rules.title: Annual meeting planning deadline
rules.summary: Hold the first annual meeting within 18 months after incorporation.

checklist: Confirm annual meeting timing against fiscal year end.
Prepare notice, agenda, and shareholder package.
Archive minutes or written resolutions.

rules.caveat: Operational date only; articles, by-laws, waivers, and meeting history can affect the workflow.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Initial return deadline
rules.summary: Ontario home corporations file the initial return within 60 days after incorporation.

checklist: Verify corporation number, registered/head office, directors, officers, and company key custody.
Prepare the initial return filing packet.
File through the Ontario Business Registry or approved service path.
Capture confirmation number, receipt, and profile-report evidence.

rules.caveat: Confirm entity-specific Ontario Business Registry instructions and filing status.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Annual return filing window
rules.summary: Track an annual return filing window from fiscal year end to an operational six-month due date.

checklist: Review Ontario Business Registry profile data.
Prepare the annual return filing packet.
File through the Ontario Business Registry or approved service path.
Archive confirmation, receipt, and profile-report evidence.

rules.caveat: Draft operational window; confirm current Ontario Business Registry annual-return instructions before filing.

rules.title: Ontario extra-provincial initial return deadline
rules.summary: The initial return clock starts when the corporation begins business in Ontario.

checklist: Verify corporation number, registered/head office, directors, officers, and company key custody.
Prepare the initial return filing packet.
File through the Ontario Business Registry or approved service path.
Capture confirmation number, receipt, and profile-report evidence.

rules.caveat: Business commencement must be recorded explicitly. Home incorporation or registry registration dates cannot substitute.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Ontario licensed foreign corporation annual return
rules.summary: Foreign corporations licensed under the Extra-Provincial Corporations Act file within six months after taxation year end.

checklist: Review Ontario Business Registry profile data.
Prepare the annual return filing packet.
File through the Ontario Business Registry or approved service path.
Archive confirmation, receipt, and profile-report evidence.

rules.caveat: Only an evidenced foreign EPCA licence establishes this class; ordinary federal CBCA registrations are excluded.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Subsequent annual meeting deadline
rules.summary: Hold the subsequent annual meeting within 15 months after the preceding AGM.

checklist: Confirm annual meeting timing against fiscal year end.
Prepare notice, agenda, and shareholder package.
Archive minutes or written resolutions.

rules.caveat: Operational date only; articles, by-laws, waivers, and meeting history can affect the workflow.
